name: Combined Technical Services Examination (Diploma / ITI Level), Notification No. 06/2026
summary: 839 posts at diploma and ITI level — Motor Vehicle Inspector, Junior Training Officer, Overseer, Draughtsman, Technical Assistant and trade instructor posts. Written examination, no interview.
whyItMatters: This is the main route into technical service for polytechnic and ITI holders, and its age structure is unusual: the general ceiling is 32, but reserved categories have no maximum age at all for almost every post.

vacancies.note: Total row of the vacancy table in para 3. Addendum 6A/2026 revised individual posts on 18 September 2026.

fee.note: ₹100 examination fee. The one-time registration fee is ₹150. Confirm in the notification.

ageRules.label: Standard diploma and ITI posts
ageRules.notes: For SC, SC(A), ST, MBC/DC, BC(OBCM) and BCM candidates the table prints ‘No maximum age limit’ against almost every post, which para 4.1.3 defines as not having completed 60 years. The general-category ceiling is 32.

citation.quote: The candidates should have completed the age of 18 years for all the posts (except Junior Training Officer Posts in Employment and Training (Training Wing)) and Motor Vehicle Inspector, Grade-II.

ageRules.label: Motor Vehicle Inspector, Grade II (Post Code 2119)

pwd.note: The table prints NA: persons with benchmark disability are not eligible for this post.

ageRules.notes: A higher minimum age (21) and a higher ceiling than the rest of the notification; PwBD candidates are expressly excluded.

citation.note: Table column heading. The values for this post are verified against the numbers printed on this page.

ageRules.label: Junior Training Officer (Post Codes 3617 to 3648 and 3773 to 3783)
ageRules.notes: These posts are unusual in using a later cut-off date (01.08.2026) than the rest of the notification, so the same candidate can be inside one limit and outside another within a single examination.

citation.quote: The candidates should have completed 21 years of age as on 01.07.2026 for Motor Vehicle Inspector, Grade-II and as on 01.08.2026 for the post of Junior Training Officer (Post Code: 3617 to 3648 and 3773 to 3783).

ageRules.label: Procurement and Quality Control Supervisor (Post Code 3772)
ageRules.notes: The only reserved-category row in the notification that prints numeric limits instead of ‘No maximum age limit’.

citation.quote: No maximum age limit shall mean that the candidates should not have completed 60 years of age
citation.note: The cited page carries both the definition paragraph and the only numeric reserved-category row in the notification.

qualifications.summary: Diploma-level technical qualifications by post: Motor Vehicle Inspector requires a three-year diploma in automobile or mechanical engineering plus a driving licence; Overseer and draughtsman posts require a civil engineering diploma; textile posts a textile or handloom diploma; ITI-level Junior Training Officer posts accept SSLC with a degree, diploma or National Trade Certificate in the relevant trade.

citation.quote: Must possess a Diploma in Electronics and Communication Engineering recognized by the Department of Technical Education or its equivalent.

specialRequirements.label: Driving licence for Motor Vehicle Inspector
specialRequirements.detail: A valid licence authorising the driving of a motorcycle with gear and a light motor vehicle is required in addition to the diploma.

citation.quote: Must hold a valid driving license authorising to drive motor cycle with gear and light motor vehicle

editorialNote: The Junior Training Officer posts use a different cut-off date from the rest of the notification; the model keeps them as a separate rule rather than averaging the two.
